summary: Copley Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on the NYSE under COPLU/COPL/COPLW, filed an 8-K disclosing that on October 9, 2026 it mutually terminated its June 10, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with Ignite Proteomics, LLC and related Pubco/Merger Sub parties. Termination occurred under Section 8.1(a) of the BCA, with only specified survival sections and Article X remaining effective; all ancillary documents, including Seller Support Agreements, Insider Letter Amendment and Lock-Up Agreements, automatically terminated. Each party bears its own expenses and mutual releases apply, terminating the deal without any stated consideration or break fee, and the SPAC must now pursue an alternative business combination or face liquidation given its trust deadline.
